subject: ddl: assign table IDs for jobs submitted to queue (#54880)
summary: Changes the legacy queue path (`addBatchDDLJobs2Queue`) to allocate all required global IDs via the existing `getRequiredGIDCount`/`assignGIDsForJobs` helpers, so `CREATE SCHEMA` and `CREATE TABLE/VIEW/SEQUENCE` jobs (including partition IDs) have stable `SchemaID`/`TableID` set before enqueue when `DDLForce2Queue` is used; no Blocker/High issues found in the touched DDL/metadata behavior.
